summary: Free one-page agency portfolio template for Framer with hero, services, projects, process and testimonials.
description: Free one-page Framer template for UI/UX designers, freelancers and creative agencies. The homepage packs a hero with video block, about, an animated services rotator, a project showcase grid with hover states, numbered process steps, testimonials and a contact CTA, plus a custom 404 page. Built with sticky scroll sections, color and font variables and SEO-ready meta; a step-by-step setup guide is built into the file.
